title: Loose Ends / nudges (get_loose_threads): routing, digest fidelity, no invented totals
notes: get_loose_threads is the nudge digest: detector-found loose threads (faded_initiator, unanswered_question, inferred_occasion, unreciprocated_goodnews), ranked by urgency and hard-capped at NUDGE_MAX_RESULTS. It returns NO population total and dormant-tie reconnect nudges are hidden until an explicit opt-in. So the model only ever sees a short list -- a faithful reply speaks to the surfaced nudges (their kinds/contacts) and never claims a grand total it was not given, nor invents a thread. GT (loose_threads_digest) supplies n_shown + the surfaced kinds/contacts as advisory evidence.

cases.prompt: Is there anyone I owe a reply to, or anything I've left hanging?
cases.grader_notes: Routes to get_loose_threads (open digest). GT raw carries n_shown, kinds, and contacts of the surfaced nudges. A good reply lists those specific loose threads (who + what kind) and does not invent threads or assert a total beyond what was returned. Naming a contact/thread absent from the digest is a faithfulness miss.
cases.quality_watch: reports only surfaced nudges; no invented total

cases.prompt: Did anyone ask me a question I never got back to?
cases.grader_notes: Routes to get_loose_threads. The model may narrow with kind='unanswered_question' OR call the bare open digest and filter unanswered questions in its narration -- both are acceptable routing (do NOT require the kind arg). GT is the unanswered_question digest (n_shown + contacts). A good reply surfaces those specific unanswered questions with their anchors and does not present other nudge kinds (faded_initiator, occasions) as if they were unanswered questions -- that kind-fidelity slip is a faithfulness miss, graded on accuracy/communication, not routing.

cases.prompt: Show me the nudges I've already dealt with.
cases.grader_notes: Routes to get_loose_threads with status='dismissed'. Dismissed rows are kept, never deleted, but the corpus likely has none -- GT n_shown may be 0. A correct reply says there are no dismissed/resolved nudges to show rather than falling back to the open digest and presenting open nudges as 'already dealt with'. thin_data probe grades manually.
cases.quality_watch: honors status=dismissed; no fallback to open nudges
